issue_context.title: Move log category to a proper field
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Instead of
```go
logutil.BgLogger().Warn("[ddl-ingest] cannot read sort path", zap.Error(err))
```

Use
```go
logutil.BgLogger().Warn("cannot read sort path", zap.Error(err), zap.String("category", "ddl-ingest"))
```

This changes the JSON logging from:
```json
{
  "level": "WARN",
  "time": "2023/06/29 12:37:30.769 +02:00",
  "caller": "env.go:52",
  "message": "[ddl-ingest] initialize environment failed",
  "storage limitation": "only support TiKV storage",
  "current storage": "unistore",
  "lightning is initialized": false
}
```

To:
```json
{
  "level": "WARN",
  "time": "2023/06/29 12:37:30.769 +02:00",
  "caller": "env.go:52",
  "message": "initialize environment failed",
  "storage limitation": "only support TiKV storage",
  "current storage": "unistore",
  "lightning is initialized": false,
  "category": "ddl-ingest"
}
```

This allows JQ to do filtering like this:
```
$ jq 'select(.category == "ddl")' /tmp/tidb.log 
{
  "level": "INFO",
  "time": "2023/06/29 13:53:32.903 +02:00",
  "caller": "ddl.go:762",
  "message": "start DDL",
  "category": "ddl",
  "ID": "b7bc92eb-9b3f-4f3b-9506-22f7a300b472",
  "runWorker": true
}
...
```

This would also allow more efficient filtering and indexing in tools like ElasticSearch or when using a table on a TiDB server to store logging.

When using the text logging instead of JSON logging this looks like this:
```
[2023/06/29 14:05:18.888 +02:00] [INFO] [ddl.go:762] ["start DDL"] [category=ddl] [ID=221d1e06-f3cd-490b-9286-3d90099ebee4] [runWorker=true]
```

Instead of this:
```
[2023/06/29 14:05:18.888 +02:00] [INFO] [ddl.go:762] ["[ddl] start DDL"] [ID=221d1e06-f3cd-490b-9286-3d90099ebee4] [runWorker=true]
```

review_comments: we can use `With()` to create the logger, so no need to repeated add the zap Fields?

I think that can be used on a case-by-case bases. Seems quite useful.

https://pkg.go.dev/go.uber.org/zap#Logger.With

I assume this would be something like this?

Instead of
```go
logutil.BgLogger().Warn("[sql-bind] BindHandle.setBindRecord", zap.Error(err0))

// or

logutil.BgLogger().Warn("BindHandle.setBindRecord", zap.Error(err0), zap.String("category", "sql-bind"))
```

Use
```go
bindLog := logutil.BgLogger().With(zap.String("category", "sql-bind"))

...

bindLog.Warn("BindHandle.setBindRecord", zap.Error(err0))
```

yes, maybe we can store `bindLog` into the receiver `BindHandle`

BTW, I'm not sure the PR is too large for you to finish them all at once 😄
@dveeden do you want to finish this PR as-is, and leave my suggestions for future change? If so, I can give a lgtm
We can create a package which uses ```logutil.Bglogger().Named("xxxx")```. it is easy to reuse the code.
